phases.instruction: Work directly in the current metashield-protocol workspace and CONTINUE from whatever local HEAD and uncommitted state actually exists. First record git branch, HEAD, status, manifest version, latest tag, upstream ahead/behind and do not destroy any pre-existing work. Read the project-local STATUS/handoff/docs and inspect the current implementation. BEFORE any tester-visible MVP behavior change, bump the Chrome extension manifest version so this RC cannot be confused with the previous build: if the actual current version is 1.0.59, set it to 1.0.60; otherwise increment the patch version by exactly one from the actual current manifest version. Human label: Chamber Sovereignty Preview RC1. Ensure the tester-visible popup/about/footer shows the numeric extension version, short git/build SHA when available, and Network: Devnet, plus a compact visible 'Sovereignty Preview · Closed Beta · Devnet' status. This version/build identity is a release-safety requirement and must survive packaging. Then implement the Chamber Sovereignty Preview MVP launch surface without deleting mature capabilities: preserve Facebook, Threads, Instagram and X/Twitter BACKUP/PRESERVATION adapters; make the default tester journey focus on identity/recovery -> select own content -> exact preview -> local encryption -> Devnet backup -> receipt -> Echo restore. De-emphasize/gate automatic Reborn composer publishing, affiliate/referral onboarding, creator revenue surfaces, complex tier comparison, ownership transfer, Genesis/governance UI from first-run/default MVP navigation while leaving existing implementation intact. Define/implement shared preservation/migration state semantics DEVNET_ONLY, MAINNET_REFERENCED, MAINNET_REPLICATED in the narrowest appropriate module/schema and add tests. Only MAINNET_REPLICATED can mean Mainnet preserved. Preserve logical_source_id as logical identity. Add/update concise project docs explaining Capture once / no source recapture. Run targeted syntax/unit/build checks for files changed. Commit only your changes with a clear MVP commit if safe; if unrelated uncommitted work prevents a clean commit, preserve it and report exact files instead of resetting/stashing destructively.

Continue from the workspace left by phase 1; inspect actual current state first and confirm the tester-visible RC version/build identity remains intact. Complete the technical Devnet Exit proof scaffold and adapter integrity gates. Implement the smallest reusable promotion/replication path that can take an existing Chamber Devnet encrypted article plus referenced encrypted media WITHOUT visiting/decrypting the source platform, preserve the same logical_source_id and Devnet provenance, create a MAINNET_REFERENCED record, replicate protocol-compatible ciphertext bytes to a second controlled/mock Mainnet target, verify bytes/hashes, and transition to MAINNET_REPLICATED only after verification. Do not make a production Mainnet write or payment. Emit a machine-readable migration receipt containing source/target IDs, logical_source_id, hashes, transition and result. Add deterministic automated tests proving no source recapture is required and hash mismatch fails closed. Audit the currently implemented Facebook/Threads/Instagram/X adapters against one common preservation contract: author/own-content check, canonical URL, text completeness signal, media completeness/limitations, logical_source_id, no silent success. Add/repair automated tests or fixtures for the contract where feasible, and mark unsupported/partial video honestly as link/poster-only rather than complete backup. Run all relevant tests/builds and fix failures caused by your changes. Commit your changes if safe without disturbing unrelated local work.

Continue from phases 1 and 2 and drive Chamber Sovereignty Preview RC1 to the strongest verifiable completion possible. Inspect exact HEAD/version/status first. DO NOT bump the version again merely because validation is starting; the RC version was intentionally bumped before Phase 1 tester-visible changes. Only bump again if another distinct tester package is actually produced after modifying the already-packaged RC. Run existing project regression/security/integrity tests, including the existing entitlement/quota gates if present, plus new migration and adapter contract tests, recovery smoke tests that are automatable, extension syntax/package integrity, and Echo production build. Exercise an automated sovereignty equivalent using stored test/fixture data: show Echo/reader restoration from Chamber-preserved data with the source adapter/source URL unavailable or deliberately not consulted. If a genuine disposable live social-post delete/unpublish proof requires interactive browser/user authority that this executor does not have, DO NOT fake it: create a precise MANUAL_ACCEPTANCE.md/checklist and mark that single live proof as external acceptance pending while completing all code/tooling needed to record it. Human label: Chamber Sovereignty Preview RC1. Produce a versioned RC artifact without --promote/public GA/Mainnet promotion; record SHA-256 and exact tested commit/tree. Verify the artifact itself displays the same manifest version, short git/build SHA where available, Network: Devnet, and RC label so the tester can positively identify the loaded build. Ensure no debug/hot-reload artifact is unintentionally shipped. Write/update a machine-readable/local project execution receipt with node/workspace, base and final HEAD, version, tests/counts/results, per-adapter support status, Devnet Exit result, sovereignty proof status, artifact path/hash, known limitations and promoted=false. Commit the RC preparation changes if safe. Return a concise final report that distinguishes COMPLETE, VERIFIED, and EXTERNAL-MANUAL-PENDING; never call RC launchable if a blocking test failed.
